newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Leonia, N.J..

text.p: in the County of Bergen, New Jersey

SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the C hief Financia Officer of the Borough of Leonia, in the County of Bergen, New Jersey (the Borough''), at the Borough Hall, 312 Broad Avenue, Leonia, New Jersey 07605 on

until 11:00 o'clock A.M. at which time they will be publicly opened and announced, for the purchase of the Borough's $2,686,000 General Improvement Bonds, dated July 15, 1997 and payable on July 15 in each year (without the right to prior redemption) as follows:

The Bonds shall be issued in registered form by means of a book-entry only system with no physical distribution of bond certificates made to the public. One bond certificate for each maturity will be issued to The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York (DTC'') and immobilized in its custody. The book-entry only system will evidence ownership of the Bonds in the principal amount of $1,000 or any multiple thereof, with transfers of ownership effected on the records of DTC and its participants pursuant to rules and procedures established by DTCand its participants. This Summary Notice of Sale is intended only as a brief summary of the Notice of Sale (the Notice of Sale''), which Notice of Sale is hereby incorporated herein by this reference thereto. The Notice of Sale and Proposal for Bonds should be reviewed by potential bidders for additional terms and conditions of the sale of the Bonds prior to bidding on the Bonds.

The Bonds will bear interest from their date at a single rate of interest in a multiple of 1/8th or 1/20th of 1% per annum specified by the successful bidder payable on each January 15 and July 15, commencing January 15, 1998, in each year until maturity. The purchase price specified must not be less than $2,686,000 nor more than $2,687,000. Bidders must at the time of making their bids deposit a certified, cashier's or treasurer's check in the amount of $53,720

drawn upon a bank or trust company to the order of Borough. The Bonds will be sold to the bidder specifying the lowest rate of interest in accordance with the terms set forth in the Notice of Sale. The Borough will furnish the Bonds and the approving legal opinion of LeBoeuf, Lamb, Greene & MacRae, L.L.P., Newark, New Jersey, Bond Counsel. The Borough has agreed in the resolution adopted by the Borough Council of the Borough on June 16, 1997 to provide or cause to be provided, in accordance with the requirements of Rule 15c2-12, (i) by not later than seven months from the end of each calendar year, commencing with the year ending December 31, 1997, certain annual financial information consisting of financial information and operating data, including audited financial statements for the preceding calendar year (or unaudited financial statements if audited financial statements are not then available), generally consistent with the annual financial information contained in the Official Statement, (ii) timely notice of the occurrence of certain material events with respect to the Bonds and (iii)timely notice of the failure of the Borough to provide the required annual information by the date specified in (i) above.

The underwriter's obligation to purchase the Bonds shall be conditioned upon its receiving, at or prior to the delivery of the Bonds, in form and substance reasonably satisfactory to the underwriter, evidence that the Borough has made the continuing disclosure undertaking set forth above in a written agreement or contract for the benefit of the holders of the Bonds.
The Bonds will be designated as

obligations'' for purposes of Section 265(b) (3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended. Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, the Notice of Sale and the Proposal for Bonds are available by contacting the undersigned Chief Financial Officer at the Borough Hall, 312 Broad Avenue, Leonia, New Jersey 07605 (telephone (201) 592-5734). By order of the the Borough Council of the Borough of Leonia.
